name: Helpless Bulldog 88
author: laminelawal
description: Outlined blue text input that lights up when focused.
howItWorks: On focus, outline becomes 1px solid #0000ff, box-shadow becomes none, width becomes 230px.
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Helpless Bulldog 88</title>
<style>
/* Helpless Bulldog 88 by laminelawal — https://uiverse.io/laminelawal/helpless-bulldog-88 */
.input {
  padding: 10px;
  width: 120px;
  border: none;
  outline: none;
  border-radius: 5px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px  gray;
  font-size: 18px;
  transition: width 0.3s;
  font-family: Consolas,monaco,monospace;
}

.input:focus {
  outline: 1px solid blue;
  box-shadow: none;
  width: 230px;
}

.input::placeholder {
  color: blue;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<input placeholder="Search..." class="input" name="text" type="text">

</body>
</html>
